chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 582: Ji Ning Fails to Open Threelives’ Treasure — Reveals Plan to Rescue Yu Wei
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning discovers he needs the fifth cycle of the Starseizing Hand to open Daofather Threelives’ legacy. He then reveals a shocking truth to Patriarch Subhuti: Yu Wei is alive, and he plans to raid the Seamless Gate alone.
og_title: Desolate Era: The Fifth Cycle Beckons
og_description: The treasure vault is locked. Only the fifth cycle can open it. But Ji Ning has a bigger plan—he’s going to make the Seamless Gate pay for Yu Wei.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 582 — Ji Ning’s Heartbreaking Confession to Subhuti
twitter_description: Ji Ning fails to open Threelives’ treasure vault and reveals to Subhuti that Yu Wei is alive, tortured in the Godking’s hells. His answer: solo raids until they beg for peace.

lore_anchors.definition: A top-ten divine ability since Pangu, allowing the user's hands to be refined into ultimate weapons; requires rare materials per cycle.
A supreme-grade Pure Yang treasure refined by Elder God Zhurong, containing eight of the nine True Fires of the Three Realms in a lotus-petal array.
A Pure Yang treasure set of ninety-nine components that creates ninety-nine Bloodshadow clones with devastating power.
Top-tier cultivation pills sent by Daofather Crimsonbright; specifically intended for training the Eight-Nine Arcane Art to its ninth cycle.
The highest grade of manufactured magic treasure below Chaos treasures; capable of empowering Empyrean Gods and True Immortals.
A treasure conceived within the primordial Chaos; virtually unmatched in power and exceedingly rare in the Three Realms.
A formless metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart; the fifth level has only been achieved by Houyi.
A primordial Elder God who perished in the ancient Dawn War; master of fire and refiner of the Eight Flames Heavenspan.
